supersedes_note: release_policy_v1.json stays valid, unchanged, for the two v1 candidates (decision replay tool). v2 adds an effect-based protocol for parameter candidates found by the effect-size screening.
applicability: Only sessions whose v2 endpoint results had not been inspected at frozen_at_utc. IC4605 (120-frame screening on 2026-09-25/26) is EXPLORATORY and excluded from confirmation. Confirmation sessions: M104, M31, M42, IC5070, M66 (reconstruction arms never run before this freeze).

measurement.output: selected candidate output of the control arm (drizzle_raw)
measurement.noise: robust high-pass sigma on the same valid background pixels, stars masked
measurement.frames: first 120 frames of the session (--max-frames 120) in every arm; downstream stages (astrometry, BGE, PCC, stretch) disabled in every arm

pairing_rules.invalid_pair_action: exclude the session and record the reason; it counts neither for nor against a candidate
pairing_rules.determinism_basis: identical configs are bit-identical (IC4605 control repeated 2026-09-25: 0 of 26702 registration values differ), so one run per arm suffices

futility_rule.rule: if after at least 4 evaluable sessions the session-level 95 % interval of the primary endpoint lies entirely above 1.0 (no improvement), the candidate is rejected_by_futility and no further sessions are run

enable_adaptive_weights.evidence: docs/PI/pi_jev_m5_evaluation_de.md (six paired sessions, matched stars; FWHM ratio 0.999-1.005 against a required <= 0.95; noise +2-3 % on half; reference frame changes)

set_pixfrac.grid_note: a lower level (0.6) is informative only: it failed the coverage gate on IC4605 (n_eff p10 = 14.0 % of frames < 15 %)

set_clip_sigmas.grid_note: the tighter production-profile level (2.0/4.0) raised noise by 49 % on IC4605 and is not a candidate direction

set_sensor_profile_dwarf_ii.reason: no independent reference luminance data; thresholds stay in release_policy_v1.json

decision_quality: Jev selection rates against labelled cases are defined in release_policy_v1.json (30 beneficial / 75 unsafe cases, Wilson bounds) and are not restated here.
